name: agent-status-card
title: Agent Status Card
description: Status card for an agent run with a task line, segmented progress and mono metadata.

props.description: Header, body, optional metadata and footer.

props.name: agentId
props.description: Designation shown above the name, for example AG-03.

props.name: name
props.description: Role or agent name. Labels the article and truncates when long.

props.name: task
props.description: One line describing what the agent is doing.

props.name: status
props.description: Drives the tone color, the status dot and the default status label.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0 to 100. Omit to hide the bar.

props.name: meta
props.description: Mono key and value pairs in equal columns.

props.name: footer
props.description: Slot under a hairline for actions.

props.name: announce
props.description: Makes the status a polite live region.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content rendered in the body under the progress bar.

variants.name: status
variants.description: Tone paints the hairline, cube, dot and progress. idle muted, running clay, review steel, blocked destructive, done moss.

accessibility: An article labelled by the name heading.
Status is always text. Dot and tone are redundant cues.
announce makes the status a polite live region. Off by default.
Tone colors keep 4.5:1 against the card in both themes.
